transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling card member services. My name is Jordan. May I have your name, please?
Customer: Hi Jordan, yeah, my name is Kenji Aldridge.
Agent: Thanks, Kenji. Could you also verify the billing zip code on your account?
Customer: Sure, it's 98104.
Agent: Thank you. How can I help you today?
Customer: Well, I need to get my money back for a charge from last month. It was for $1,350.00 at Restwell Furniture.
Agent: I see a charge for $1,350.00 from Restwell Furniture on September 5th. What happened with this transaction?
Customer: I ordered a sectional sofa from them. They delivered it, but now that I've been sitting on it for about a month, it's just really uncomfortable.
Agent: When it was delivered, was there any damage to the sofa?
Customer: No, it wasn't broken or anything. It showed up right on time and looked just like the picture in the catalog.
Agent: So the item matched what you ordered when it arrived?
Customer: Yeah, the style, the fabric, the color, all that was right. There were no tears or broken parts.
Agent: Have you spoken with Restwell Furniture regarding your concerns with the sofa?
Customer: I called them yesterday, but they said they don't take returns after thirty days, especially if it's been sat on every day. But my back is killing me, so I really can't keep it.
Agent: Did they offer any other options or exchanges?
Customer: No, they basically just said all sales are final after the initial delivery window, so they wouldn't do a refund. That's why I'm calling you guys to get my $1,350.00 back.
Agent: Just to make sure I have all the details noted correctly, you purchased a sofa from Restwell Furniture for $1,350.00 on September 5th, it arrived in proper condition matching the order, but after a month of use you find it uncomfortable, and the merchant declined a return based on their return timeframe. Is that accurate?
Customer: Yes, that's exactly what happened.
